winter_f_road_prohibited.description: F-roads and interior highland corridors are seasonally closed or inappropriate for typical consumer travel in Icelandic winter months; treat as operational prohibition unless explicitly opened per official sources (e.g. road.is).

two_wheel_drive_f_road_prohibited.description: 2WD vehicles are prohibited on F-roads and highland tracks regardless of season under typical rental and insurance terms in Iceland.

red_alert_life_safety.description: When SafeTravel / official travel-safety feeds indicate red-tier (critical) alerts that match the user's stated regions or an Iceland-anchored trip, the assistant must not normalize risk or suggest proceeding; defer to official guidance and emergency services.

wind_safety_pickup.description: Operational wind-safety guidance for vehicle pickup/door handling and cross-wind driving near alerts; WARNING-tier consumer messaging, not a legal prohibition gate.
